impact_scope.description: Introduces the public handsum.decoder image-decoder lifecycle surface anchored by the new decoder declaration.

evidence: S0 has no matching Handsum decoder declaration, so this exact API and its exposure obligation did not exist.
S1 introduces handsum.decoder implementing base.image_decoder with public image-configuration and frame-decoding lifecycle calls.
H0 enables and exercises only the JSON modules and JSON decoder paths; it neither enables the Handsum module nor constructs or invokes handsum.decoder.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 would need a Handsum-specific entry path: enable the Handsum module, instantiate its decoder, supply Handsum bytes and image output storage, and invoke the image-decoder lifecycle.
evidence: These caller-side configuration, construction, buffer, and lifecycle actions were unnecessary in S0 because handsum.decoder was absent.
The existing JSON decode paths cannot reach the new Handsum decoder surface.

reason: The anchored public decoder is newly introduced in S1. Therefore its own S0 gap is false, while unchanged H0 leaves the new callable lifecycle entirely unexposed in S1. This creates a concrete new caller-visible harness obligation and is classified NEW.
